name: The St Regis Singapore
positioning: St. Regis hotel at the crossroads of the Orchard Road shopping belt, the Singapore Botanic Gardens and the Embassy District, with a private art collection and complimentary butler service
best_for: Travelers who want a base one block from Orchard Road, near the Singapore Botanic Gardens
Guests who enjoy art and hotel rituals such as afternoon tea and champagne sabrage
Families with children aged 12 and under

facts.text: The hotel is at the crossroads of the Orchard Road shopping belt, the Singapore Botanic Gardens and the Embassy District.
The hotel is located one block from Orchard Road.
The St. Regis Singapore officially opened in 2008.
Room interiors use botanical references, with calming tones of blue and aqua, timber-wood flooring and bespoke furnishings.
Every guest room has a marble bathroom with double vanities, a standing shower and a separate bathtub.
Rooms have potable hot and cold water on tap, a casting-enabled TV and a Bluetooth sound bar.
Sophia, the Italian restaurant, has a dining room inspired by a glasshouse.
Tentsuru, led by Chef Daiki Kawaguchi, showcases seasonal ingredients flown in fresh from Japan.
Afternoon tea at The Tea Room features unlimited scones, artisanal jams and clotted cream.
The St. Regis Spa has indoor and outdoor jacuzzis, cedarwood Finnish saunas and eucalyptus steam chambers.
The outdoor pool is on level 2.
The Family Traditions program gives guests aged 12 and under amenities such as bathrobes, bedroom slippers and bath essentials.

highlights.text: The hotel has a private art collection of more than 70 works, from Pablo Picasso and Marc Chagall to Singaporean and Asian artists such as Georgette Chen, Anthony Poon and Li Chen.
A complimentary butler-led hotel art tour runs daily; advance reservation is required.
A champagne sabrage ritual takes place on the Grand Staircase every evening.
The Straits Mary, the hotel's local twist on the Bloody Mary, features bak kwa-infused whisky and chilli padi.
Complimentary butler services include packing and unpacking of luggage, beverage service, daily garment pressing and shoe shine.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
The nearest MRT stations, Orchard and Orchard Boulevard, are about a 10-minute walk away.
A teepee tent can be set up in family rooms for an additional charge.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: The St. Regis Singapore
